# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Q1 2026 Per-Property P&L (Ski-In/Out Condos)

**Generated by: Finance & Trust skill**
**Period:** Jan 1 – Mar 31, 2026 (Q1)
**Segment:** Canyons Village ski-in/ski-out condos (PC-01 to PC-08, 8 properties)
**Prepared by:** Marcus Friedman
**Distributed to:** Jamie (GM), Hannah (Owner Relations), and shared with each owner via their individual quarterly statements

---

## Segment Summary

The 8 ski-in/ski-out condos delivered the strongest Q1 in their history: **gross booking revenue $487,820**, owner net payouts of **$295,640**, and management fees to Pinecrest of **$92,840**. Average occupancy 76% (peak ski season skew); blended ADR $632.

**Top performer:** PC-04 (Eagle's Perch) — $112,840 revenue, 89% occupancy, NPS 67. **Bottom:** PC-08 (Cedar Walk-Up) — $26,400 revenue, 64% occupancy, hot-tub work order eroded margins.

## Margin Analysis

### Pinecrest Margin per Property

| Property | Pinecrest fee | Direct cost (cleaning, supplies, OTA mgmt time) | Net margin to Pinecrest | Margin % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| PC-01 | $10,284 | $1,840 | $8,444 | 82% |
| PC-02 | $15,284 | $2,140 | $13,144 | 86% |
| PC-03 | $7,236 | $2,440 (high — many small bookings) | $4,796 | 66% |
| PC-04 | $20,311 | $1,920 | $18,391 | 91% — highest |
| PC-05 | $8,788 | $1,890 | $6,898 | 78% |
| PC-06 | $12,316 | $2,240 | $10,076 | 82% |
| PC-07 | $9,151 | $1,820 | $7,331 | 80% |
| PC-08 | $6,600 | $2,140 (work-order coordination time) | $4,460 | 68% |

**Read:** PC-04 is our marquee unit — high revenue, low ops overhead, 91% margin. PC-03 (studio) has the worst margin because of the high-volume / low-revenue booking pattern. PC-08 also at the bottom because it requires more management attention per dollar of revenue.

## Bottom-Decile / Watch List

PC-08 (Mei-Lin Zhao) is the only property in this segment trailing portfolio targets:
- RevPAR $284 (vs. portfolio target $534) — primarily a function of unit size (studio); not a reflection of management quality
- Owner relations escalation in flight (see churn-risk tracker)
- **Recommended action:** intervention via Hannah; if unresolved by May 27, GM call

PC-03 (Joshua Greenwood) is also studio-class but performing strongly (87% occupancy). No intervention needed.

## Recommendations for Q2

1. **Onboard PC-04, PC-05, PC-06 to Booking.com Sep 1** (subject to board approval Jun 15). Estimated incremental revenue: $36–60K combined for the 2026–27 ski season.
2. **Resolve PC-08 (Mei-Lin) payout dispute by end of May.** Risk: she terminates; cost of replacement = ~$2,400 onboarding + 6-month void.
3. **PC-04 listing remains the gold standard** — pull it as the case study in the next Westridge LLC quarterly review (Diane in May 22).
4. **PC-03 is over-performing on occupancy** — consider increasing ADR by 5% in Q2 (PriceLabs already nudging).
5. **All 4 Westridge properties should be presented as a portfolio at the next quarterly review** with a multi-year commitment offer (consistent with churn-risk plan for Northstar).
